data.title: 菲伦 · 王都舞会
data.description: 【菲伦 · 王都舞会】灯火辉煌的王都宫廷舞厅内，换上华丽露肩晚礼服的菲伦在悠扬的华尔兹乐曲中轻轻提起裙摆，向你微微欠身施礼，紫眸中泛着少见的娇美——「我并不擅长跳舞，如果踩到您的脚……请务必提前原谅我。那么，能请您带我跳第一支舞吗？」
data.camera: full-body shot, slight frontal angle, complete curtsy visible
data.promptProse: Before the waltz, Fern gathers her violet satin gown in both white-gloved hands and offers a careful curtsy, knees bent slightly beneath a shy lowered smile. Her purple hair is arranged in a formal updo. The full-body frontal view keeps her hem clear of the polished ballroom floor, which leads toward receding columns. Chandelier light highlights satin crests and gloves, with darker folds and a gentle floor reflection below.
